title: 液晶空間光調制器~Liquid-crystal spatial light modulators
focus: 反射式 LCOS 相位調制器的相位行程、像素繞射、液晶響應、查找表校正與系統整合~Phase stroke, pixel diffraction, liquid-crystal response, lookup-table calibration and system integration of reflective LCOS phase modulators
summary: 以 8 µm 像素、1920×1200 的反射式 LCOS 相位調制器為對象，從向列型液晶的雙折射推導 2π 相位行程與單元間隙的關係，計算像素化閃耀光柵的繞射效率與最大偏折角，再把液晶響應時間、相位閃爍、溫度漂移與背板平整度整合成查找表校正與波前修正流程，最後以傅立葉光學系統的驗收指標完成交接。~Taking an 8 µm pixel, 1920×1200 reflective LCOS phase modulator as the object, the course derives the 2π phase stroke against cell gap from nematic birefringence, computes diffraction efficiency and maximum steering angle of pixelated blazed gratings, then folds liquid-crystal response time, phase flicker, temperature drift and backplane flatness into a lookup-table calibration and wavefront-correction flow, closing with acceptance metrics of a Fourier-optics system.

units.anchor: 平行配向向列液晶層~Parallel-aligned nematic LC layer
units.title: 雙折射與 2π 相位行程~Birefringence and the 2π phase stroke
units.mechanism: 相位型液晶調制器使用平行配向的向列型液晶：無電場時液晶指向矢平行基板，沿此方向偏振的光感受非常光折射率 n_e；加電壓後指向矢朝電場方向傾斜，有效折射率往尋常光折射率 n_o 下降，穿越厚度 d 的光程隨之改變而偏振態不變，這就是純相位調制。反射式 LCOS 讓光來回穿過液晶層兩次，所以同樣的單元間隙給出兩倍的相位行程；靠近配向層的分子無法完全傾斜，實際可用的折射率差只有材料 Δn 的七到八成。~A phase-only liquid-crystal modulator uses a parallel-aligned nematic: with no field the director lies parallel to the substrates and light polarized along it sees the extraordinary index n_e; with voltage the director tilts toward the field, the effective index falls toward the ordinary index n_o, and the optical path through thickness d changes while the polarization state stays fixed, which is pure phase modulation. A reflective LCOS passes light through the layer twice, so the same cell gap gives double the phase stroke; molecules near the alignment layers cannot tilt fully, so the usable index change is only 70 to 80% of the material Δn.
units.model: 反射式相位行程 φ_max = 2π·2·Δn_eff·d/λ。Δn = 0.20、可用 Δn_eff = 0.15 時，在 633 nm 達 2π 的最小間隙 d = λ/(2Δn_eff) = 633/0.30 ≈ 2.1 µm；1064 nm 需 3.55 µm；d = 3 µm 的元件在 532 nm 給 1.69×2π，在 1064 nm 只有 0.85×2π，不足一圈。~The reflective phase stroke is φ_max = 2π·2·Δn_eff·d/λ. With Δn = 0.20 and usable Δn_eff = 0.15, the minimum gap for 2π at 633 nm is d = λ/(2Δn_eff) = 633/0.30 ≈ 2.1 µm, and 1064 nm needs 3.55 µm; a 3 µm cell gives 1.69×2π at 532 nm but only 0.85×2π at 1064 nm, short of a full cycle.
units.verify: 把調制器放在 45° 交叉偏振片之間，以灰階 0 到 255 掃描並記錄穿透強度，強度隨相位差以 sin²(Δφ/2) 振盪，數振盪週期即可得總相位行程；再換波長重做，確認行程與 1/λ 成正比。~Place the modulator between polarizers at 45°, sweep grey levels from 0 to 255 and record the transmitted intensity, which oscillates as sin²(Δφ/2) with the phase difference; counting the oscillation periods gives the total stroke, and repeating at another wavelength confirms that the stroke scales as 1/λ.
units.failure: 把為可見光選的 2 µm 間隙元件用在 1064 nm，相位只到 1.2π，閃耀光柵的相位包裹處出現 0.8π 的缺口，光被散回零階，繞射效率不到三成。~Using a 2 µm gap chosen for the visible at 1064 nm yields only about 1.2π of phase; every wrap of a blazed grating leaves a 0.8π gap, light is thrown back into the zeroth order and diffraction efficiency falls below 30%.
units.misconception: 相位行程越大越好，所以單元間隙應盡量厚。~A larger phase stroke is always better, so the cell gap should be as thick as possible.

units.anchor: 像素格點與閃耀光柵圖樣~Pixel lattice and blazed-grating pattern
units.title: 像素化繞射與偏折效率~Pixelated diffraction and steering efficiency
units.mechanism: 液晶調制器的相位圖是以像素週期 p 取樣的階梯函數，任何圖樣都同時受三個因素限制：相鄰像素的最小週期 2p 決定最大偏折角；一個鋸齒週期內的像素數 N 決定階梯近似閃耀面的效率 sinc²(1/N)；像素間隙與電極邊緣的邊緣電場使相位在像素邊界被平滑，短週期圖樣的實際效率低於純量預測。填充因子以外的面積反射未調制光，成為無法消除的零階。~The phase map of a liquid-crystal modulator is a staircase sampled at the pixel pitch p, and every pattern is limited by three factors at once: the minimum period of 2p sets the maximum steering angle; the number of pixels N per sawtooth period sets the staircase efficiency sinc²(1/N) relative to an ideal blaze; and inter-pixel gaps plus fringing fields at electrode edges smooth the phase across pixel boundaries, so short-period patterns fall below the scalar prediction. The area outside the fill factor reflects unmodulated light that becomes an irreducible zeroth order.
units.model: p = 8 µm、λ = 633 nm：最大偏折 sinθ_max = λ/(2p) = 0.0396，θ_max ≈ 2.27°。閃耀效率 η = sinc²(1/N)：N = 8 時 95.0%，N = 4 時 81.1%，N = 2 時 40.5%；填充因子 95.6% 表示至少 4.4% 的光未被相位控制。~For p = 8 µm and λ = 633 nm the maximum steering follows sinθ_max = λ/(2p) = 0.0396, θ_max ≈ 2.27°. Blaze efficiency η = sinc²(1/N) is 95.0% for N = 8, 81.1% for N = 4 and 40.5% for N = 2; a fill factor of 95.6% means at least 4.4% of the light escapes phase control.
units.verify: 顯示週期 N = 2、4、8、16 像素的閃耀光柵，用功率計分別量一階與零階功率並除以入射功率，畫出效率對 N 的曲線與 sinc²(1/N) 比較；短週期處的額外損失即為邊緣電場效應，供後續圖樣設計避開。~Display blazed gratings with periods of N = 2, 4, 8 and 16 pixels, measure first- and zeroth-order power with a power meter relative to the input and plot efficiency against N beside sinc²(1/N); the extra loss at short periods quantifies the fringing-field effect so later pattern design can avoid it.
units.failure: 為了把光束偏到 2° 而使用 2 像素週期，實際一階效率只剩 20% 左右，其餘光集中在零階形成高亮斑，若恰好落在樣品或偵測器上會造成損傷或飽和。~Steering to 2° with a two-pixel period leaves only about 20% in the first order; the rest concentrates in a bright zeroth-order spot that damages or saturates whatever sits at the zero-order position.
units.misconception: 只要像素數夠多，調制器能把光偏到任意角度。~With enough pixels the modulator can steer light to any angle.

units.anchor: CMOS 背板、像素電極與蓋玻璃~CMOS backplane, pixel electrodes and cover glass
units.title: LCOS 元件結構與背板平整度~LCOS device structure and backplane flatness
units.mechanism: LCOS 元件由 CMOS 矽背板、頂層金屬像素電極兼反射鏡、配向層、液晶層、ITO 共同電極與蓋玻璃疊成；像素電極之上可再鍍介電多層膜把反射率從鋁的約 90% 提高到 98% 以承受高功率。背板經封裝與蓋玻璃貼合後會產生數個波長的彎曲，單元間隙也會沿孔徑漸變，兩者都疊加在輸出波前上；高精度應用因此把背板面形當成一個固定像差，以干涉儀量測後用相位圖抵消。~An LCOS device stacks a CMOS silicon backplane, top-metal pixel electrodes that double as mirrors, alignment layers, the liquid-crystal layer, an ITO common electrode and a cover glass; a dielectric multilayer over the electrodes raises reflectance from about 90% for aluminium to 98% for high-power use. After packaging and cover-glass bonding the backplane bows by several wavelengths and the cell gap ramps across the aperture, and both add to the output wavefront; precision applications therefore treat the backplane figure as a fixed aberration, measure it interferometrically and cancel it with a phase map.
units.model: 單元間隙沿 15 mm 孔徑漸變 Δd = 50 nm 時，相位行程差 Δφ = 2π·2·Δn_eff·Δd/λ = 2π×2×0.15×0.05/0.633 ≈ 0.15 rad ≈ λ/42，可接受；背板彎曲 PV = 1 λ 則是 6.3 rad 的固定像差，不修正時 Strehl 遠低於 0.1，必須以修正圖抵消。~A cell-gap ramp of Δd = 50 nm across a 15 mm aperture changes the stroke by Δφ = 2π·2·Δn_eff·Δd/λ = 2π×2×0.15×0.05/0.633 ≈ 0.15 rad ≈ λ/42, which is acceptable; a backplane bow of PV = 1 λ is a fixed aberration of 6.3 rad that leaves Strehl far below 0.1 unless cancelled by a correction map.
units.verify: 以 Fizeau 干涉儀在調制器顯示均勻灰階時量反射波前，分離出背板面形（與灰階無關）與間隙漸變（隨灰階改變的部分）；把面形轉成修正相位圖載入後再量一次，殘差應低於 λ/10 PV。~Measure the reflected wavefront with a Fizeau interferometer while the modulator shows a uniform grey level, separating the backplane figure (grey-level independent) from the gap ramp (the part that changes with grey level); load the figure as a correction map and re-measure, with a residual below λ/10 PV.
units.failure: 蓋玻璃以硬膠固定後，溫度每變 10 K 背板彎曲改變約 λ/4，固定的修正圖在冷機與熱機狀態之間失效，聚焦光斑隨時間緩慢變形。~With the cover glass fixed by a rigid adhesive, every 10 K of temperature change alters the bow by about λ/4; a fixed correction map stops working between cold and warm states and the focused spot slowly deforms over time.
units.misconception: 矽背板是拋光晶圓，所以反射面天生就平。~The silicon backplane is a polished wafer, so the mirror surface is inherently flat.

units.anchor: 液晶鬆弛動力學與驅動波形~LC relaxation dynamics and drive waveform
units.title: 響應時間、驅動與相位閃爍~Response time, addressing and phase flicker
units.mechanism: 液晶加電時由電場驅動而快速傾斜，去電後只靠彈性回復，所以關閉時間最慢並與間隙平方成正比、與旋轉黏度成正比；這使得為長波長加厚間隙的元件響應明顯變慢。液晶必須以交流驅動避免離子累積，數位背板以脈寬調變合成有效電壓，位元平面切換造成相位隨時間抖動（閃爍）；類比背板直接保持電壓，閃爍小但需要更複雜的驅動與直流平衡。~Under voltage the liquid crystal tilts quickly because the field drives it, but after the voltage is removed it relaxes by elasticity alone, so the off time is the slowest and scales with the square of the gap and with rotational viscosity; cells thickened for long wavelengths respond markedly slower. The liquid crystal must be driven with alternating polarity to avoid ion accumulation; digital backplanes synthesize the effective voltage by pulse-width modulation and bit-plane switching makes the phase jitter in time (flicker), whereas analog backplanes hold the voltage directly with little flicker at the cost of more complex drive and DC balancing.
units.model: 關閉時間 τ_off ≈ γ₁·d²/(π²·K)，與間隙平方成正比：旋轉黏度 γ₁ = 0.1 Pa·s、彈性常數 K = 10 pN、間隙 d = 3 µm 時 τ_off ≈ 0.1×9×10⁻¹²/(9.87×10⁻¹¹) ≈ 9.1 ms；d = 4 µm 時為 16.2 ms。以 3 倍閾值電壓開啟時 τ_on ≈ τ_off/((V/V_th)² − 1) ≈ 1.1 ms。~τ_off ≈ γ₁·d²/(π²·K): with γ₁ = 0.1 Pa·s, K = 10 pN and d = 3 µm, τ_off ≈ 0.1×9×10⁻¹²/(9.87×10⁻¹¹) ≈ 9.1 ms, and 16.2 ms for d = 4 µm. Switching on at three times the threshold voltage gives τ_on ≈ τ_off/((V/V_th)² − 1) ≈ 1.1 ms.
units.verify: 在交叉偏振片組態下以光電二極體與示波器記錄灰階階躍後的強度暫態，取 10% 到 90% 的時間為響應時間；再在穩態灰階下用高頻取樣看強度的週期性起伏，換算成相位閃爍的峰對峰值，與元件規格的相位穩定度比較。~In the crossed-polarizer configuration record the intensity transient after a grey-level step with a photodiode and oscilloscope, taking the 10% to 90% time as the response; then sample at high rate at a steady grey level to see periodic intensity ripple, convert it to peak-to-peak phase flicker and compare with the device's phase-stability specification.
units.failure: 以數位背板做 1 kHz 以上的高速相位切換，位元平面的閃爍與液晶鬆弛疊加，每幀平均相位偏離目標 0.3 rad，全像再現影像亮度隨時間起伏並出現幀間鬼影。~Driving a digital backplane for phase switching above 1 kHz lets bit-plane flicker and LC relaxation overlap; the mean phase per frame misses the target by 0.3 rad, the reconstructed hologram brightness fluctuates and inter-frame ghosts appear.
units.misconception: 液晶響應時間由驅動電子的幀率決定。~The liquid-crystal response time is set by the frame rate of the drive electronics.

units.anchor: 灰階對相位查找表~Grey-level-to-phase lookup table
units.title: 相位查找表校正~Phase lookup-table calibration
units.mechanism: 驅動電壓與相位之間是非線性的，且隨波長、溫度與元件個體而異，所以每片調制器在每個工作波長都要建立灰階對相位的查找表。常用的繞射法把一半像素固定在灰階 g₀、另一半掃描灰階 g，構成二元光柵，一階強度隨相位差以 sin²(Δφ/2) 變化，由強度曲線反演相位；干涉法則把調制器分成兩區，一區當參考，用相機量條紋位移。目標是讓灰階 0 到 2π 的對應成線性，使相位量化均勻。~Drive voltage and phase are related nonlinearly and the relation changes with wavelength, temperature and device, so every modulator needs a grey-level-to-phase lookup table at each working wavelength. The common diffraction method fixes half of the pixels at grey level g₀ and sweeps the other half through g to form a binary grating whose first-order intensity varies as sin²(Δφ/2) with the phase difference, from which the phase is inverted; the interferometric method splits the modulator into two zones, uses one as reference and reads fringe shifts with a camera. The goal is a linear map from grey level to 0–2π so that phase quantization is uniform.
units.model: 若二元光柵一階強度在灰階 180 時回到零，表示 2π 落在 180 級；重新映射後每級 2π/180 = 0.0349 rad，量化效率 sinc²(1/180) ≈ 99.99%，與 256 級的 0.0245 rad 沒有實質差別。校正從 633 nm 換到 532 nm 時相位放大 633/532 = 1.19 倍，必須重做。~If the first-order intensity of the binary grating returns to zero at grey level 180, 2π sits at 180 levels; after remapping each level is 2π/180 = 0.0349 rad with quantization efficiency sinc²(1/180) ≈ 99.99%, no practical difference from 0.0245 rad at 256 levels. Moving from 633 nm to 532 nm scales phase by 633/532 = 1.19, so the calibration must be redone.
units.verify: 完成查找表後顯示 N = 8 像素的閃耀光柵，量一階效率應接近 95% 乘以反射率與填充因子；再把光柵相位整體加 0、π/2、π 的偏置，一階效率不應改變，這證明查找表在整個 0 到 2π 都線性。~After building the table, display an N = 8 blazed grating and confirm first-order efficiency near 95% times reflectance and fill factor; then add global offsets of 0, π/2 and π to the grating phase, and the first-order efficiency must not change, proving linearity over the whole 0 to 2π.
units.failure: 沿用出廠 633 nm 查找表在 532 nm 工作，相位被放大 19%，鋸齒頂端過衝 0.38π，閃耀效率降到七成以下，殘餘光進入零階與負一階。~Reusing the factory 633 nm table at 532 nm scales phase by 19%, the sawtooth overshoots by 0.38π at each wrap, blaze efficiency drops below 70% and the remainder leaks into the zeroth and minus-first orders.
units.misconception: 出廠查找表對任何波長與溫度都適用。~The factory lookup table applies at any wavelength and temperature.

units.anchor: 溫度、功率與相位誤差預算表~Temperature, power and phase-error budget
units.title: 相位誤差預算與熱負載~Phase-error budget and thermal load
units.mechanism: 影響輸出波前的誤差來源有五類：查找表殘差、相位閃爍、背板修正殘差、單元間隙漸變與溫度漂移。液晶的雙折射隨溫度上升而下降，相位行程跟著縮，而吸收的雷射功率又會加熱液晶層，所以高功率下相位對灰階的對應會隨時間漂移。各項以均方根相加換算成 Strehl 比，才能決定需要水冷、溫控或定期重校。~Five classes of error affect the output wavefront: lookup-table residual, phase flicker, backplane-correction residual, cell-gap ramp and temperature drift. Liquid-crystal birefringence falls as temperature rises so the phase stroke shrinks, and absorbed laser power heats the layer, so at high power the phase-to-grey mapping drifts over time. The items are root-sum-squared and converted into a Strehl ratio before deciding whether water cooling, temperature control or periodic recalibration is required.
units.model: 取 dΔn/dT ≈ −5×10⁻⁴/K，溫升 5 K 使 Δn_eff 由 0.150 降到 0.1475（−1.7%），滿行程 2π 的頂端少了 0.105 rad。預算：查找表 0.08 rad、閃爍 0.15 rad、修正殘差 0.12 rad、溫漂 0.10 rad，RSS σ_φ ≈ 0.23 rad，Strehl ≈ exp(−0.23²) ≈ 0.95。~With dΔn/dT ≈ −5×10⁻⁴/K, a 5 K rise lowers Δn_eff from 0.150 to 0.1475 (−1.7%) and the top of a full 2π stroke falls short by 0.105 rad. Budget: lookup table 0.08 rad, flicker 0.15 rad, correction residual 0.12 rad, thermal drift 0.10 rad, RSS σ_φ ≈ 0.23 rad and Strehl ≈ exp(−0.23²) ≈ 0.95.
units.verify: 在額定功率照射下每 10 分鐘重做一次二元光柵校正曲線並記錄背板溫度，繪出 2π 灰階位置對溫度的斜率；同時用功率計監測一階效率衰減，確認預算中溫漂項的假設與實測一致。~Under rated illumination repeat the binary-grating calibration every 10 minutes while logging backplane temperature, plot the grey level of 2π against temperature to get its slope, and monitor first-order efficiency decay with a power meter to confirm that the thermal-drift assumption in the budget matches measurement.
units.failure: 鋁反射層元件在 2 W 的 1064 nm 光下吸收約 10%，液晶層升溫超過 15 K，相位行程掉到 1.8π，光束整形圖樣的邊緣出現亮環，關機冷卻後又恢復，難以在驗收時重現。~An aluminium-mirror device under 2 W at 1064 nm absorbs about 10%, the liquid-crystal layer warms by more than 15 K, the stroke drops to 1.8π and bright rings appear at the edge of the beam-shaping pattern; after cooling it recovers, so the fault is hard to reproduce at acceptance.
units.misconception: 反射式調制器不吸收光，所以沒有熱效應。~A reflective modulator does not absorb light, so it has no thermal effects.

units.anchor: 偏振器、傅立葉透鏡與零階擋板~Polarizer, Fourier lens and zero-order stop
units.title: 傅立葉光學系統整合~Fourier-optics system integration
units.mechanism: 整合時把調制器放在傅立葉透鏡的前焦面，目標圖樣就出現在後焦面；入射光須以線偏振對準液晶指向矢，入射角保持在 10° 以內以免相位行程按 cosθ 縮減並混入振幅調制。零階光總是聚在後焦面中心，可用空間擋板遮蔽或在相位圖上加線性相位斜坡把工作圖樣移開。可定址的視場由最大偏折角與焦距決定，光斑大小由孔徑決定，兩者的比值就是可解析點數。~For integration the modulator sits in the front focal plane of a Fourier lens so that the target pattern forms in the back focal plane; the input must be linearly polarized along the director, with incidence kept within 10° so that the stroke is not reduced by cosθ and no amplitude modulation is mixed in. The zeroth order always focuses at the centre of the back focal plane and is either blocked by a spatial stop or pushed aside by adding a linear phase ramp to the pattern. The addressable field follows from maximum steering angle and focal length, the spot size from the aperture, and their ratio is the number of resolvable points.
units.model: f = 300 mm、p = 8 µm、λ = 633 nm：可定址半視場 = f·tan(2.27°) ≈ 11.9 mm；孔徑 D = 1920×8 µm = 15.4 mm 的繞射光斑 1.22λf/D = 1.22×0.633×300/15.4 ≈ 15 µm；每軸可解析點數約 N/2 = 960。~With f = 300 mm, p = 8 µm and λ = 633 nm the addressable half-field is f·tan(2.27°) ≈ 11.9 mm; the diffraction spot for an aperture D = 1920×8 µm = 15.4 mm is 1.22λf/D = 1.22×0.633×300/15.4 ≈ 15 µm; the number of resolvable points per axis is about N/2 = 960.
units.verify: 顯示單一線性相位斜坡，使焦點以 0.5 mm 步進移動到視場邊緣，用相機記錄光斑位置與大小，位置應與 f·sinθ 線性相符、光斑直徑維持約 15 µm；另以偏振片旋轉 5° 檢查一階效率的下降量，確認偏振對準公差。~Display a single linear phase ramp to walk the focus in 0.5 mm steps to the field edge, record spot position and size with a camera, check that position follows f·sinθ linearly and the spot stays near 15 µm; then rotate the input polarizer by 5° and note the efficiency drop to set the polarization-alignment tolerance.
units.failure: 入射角設成 30° 以方便機構擺放，相位行程縮到 cos30° 倍且 s 與 p 分量混合，調制器同時產生振幅調制，再現圖樣對比下降且出現與圖樣無關的條紋。~Setting a 30° incidence to simplify the mechanics scales the stroke by cos30° and mixes s and p components, so the modulator also modulates amplitude; the reconstructed pattern loses contrast and shows fringes unrelated to the pattern.
units.misconception: 零階光可以靠改進相位圖完全消除。~The zeroth order can be eliminated completely by a better phase pattern.

units.anchor: 驗收報告與校正檔案包~Acceptance report and calibration file package
units.title: 效率驗收與工程交接~Efficiency acceptance and engineering handoff
units.mechanism: 交接時要把調制器當成一個帶有校正檔案的光學元件：每個工作波長的查找表、背板修正相位圖、量測的相位行程、響應時間、閃爍、效率對光柵週期曲線與熱漂移斜率，都必須附上量測條件與日期。驗收指標以理論效率扣除反射率與填充因子後的比值表示，才能分辨是元件退化還是系統對準問題；壽命項則追蹤液晶在紫外與高功率下的雙折射衰減。~At handoff the modulator is treated as an optical element shipped with calibration files: the lookup table for each working wavelength, the backplane correction map, measured stroke, response time, flicker, the efficiency-versus-period curve and the thermal-drift slope, each with measurement conditions and date. Acceptance is expressed as the ratio of measured efficiency to the theoretical value after reflectance and fill factor are removed, so that device degradation can be told from system misalignment; the lifetime item tracks birefringence decay of the liquid crystal under ultraviolet and high power.
units.model: N = 8 閃耀光柵的期望一階效率 = 0.950×反射率 0.90×填充因子 0.956 ≈ 0.817；實測 0.78 時比值 0.78/0.817 ≈ 0.95，高於 0.90 的驗收門檻；零階殘留應 ≤ 5%，修正後波前 ≤ λ/7 PV，相位閃爍峰對峰 ≤ 0.2 rad。~The expected first-order efficiency of an N = 8 blaze is 0.950 × reflectance 0.90 × fill factor 0.956 ≈ 0.817; a measured 0.78 gives a ratio of 0.78/0.817 ≈ 0.95, above the 0.90 acceptance threshold; residual zeroth order must be ≤ 5%, corrected wavefront ≤ λ/7 PV and peak-to-peak phase flicker ≤ 0.2 rad.
units.verify: 依序執行：功率計量閃耀效率與零階、干涉儀量修正後波前、光電二極體量閃爍、溫控箱量熱漂移斜率，把結果與校正檔案的雜湊值一起寫入驗收報告；三個月後重量效率，衰減超過 5% 即觸發重新校正。~Run in order: power-meter blaze efficiency and zeroth order, interferometer corrected wavefront, photodiode flicker and climate-chamber thermal-drift slope; write the results with hash values of the calibration files into the acceptance report, and re-measure efficiency after three months, with a decay beyond 5% triggering recalibration.
units.failure: 系統端只收到一個「2π 可達」的描述而沒有查找表檔案與修正圖，重新用預設線性表驅動後閃耀效率只有 60%，誤以為元件損壞而退貨。~The system team receives only a statement that 2π is reachable, without lookup-table files or the correction map; driving with a default linear table yields 60% blaze efficiency and the device is wrongly returned as damaged.
units.misconception: 調制器是標準品，不需要隨機附校正檔案。~A modulator is a standard part and needs no device-specific calibration files.

example: 設計練習：為 532 nm 與 1064 nm 兩用的反射式 LCOS 相位調制器選單元間隙。材料 Δn = 0.20、可用 Δn_eff = 0.15。行程 φ_max = 2π·2·Δn_eff·d/λ：d = 3 µm 在 532 nm 給 2π×(2×0.15×3/0.532) = 1.69×2π，在 1064 nm 只有 0.85×2π，不合格；改 d = 4 µm 則 1064 nm 得 1.13×2π，532 nm 得 2.26×2π，兩波長皆可包裹到 2π。代價是響應：τ_off = γ₁d²/(π²K) = 0.1×16×10⁻¹²/(9.87×10⁻¹¹) ≈ 16 ms，比 3 µm 的 9 ms 慢 1.8 倍。顯示 8 像素週期（p = 8 µm）閃耀光柵，532 nm 的偏折角 sinθ = 0.532/64 = 0.0083（0.48°），f = 300 mm 時焦點移動 2.5 mm；理論效率 sinc²(1/8) = 95%，乘上反射率 0.90 與填充因子 0.956 得 81.7%。查找表若把 2π 對應到灰階 200，每級 0.0314 rad，可忽略量化損失。相位閃爍 σ = 0.15 rad 時 Strehl ≈ exp(−0.0225) ≈ 0.978。數值為教學假設。~Design exercise: choose the cell gap of a reflective LCOS phase modulator meant for both 532 nm and 1064 nm. The material has Δn = 0.20 with usable Δn_eff = 0.15. The stroke φ_max = 2π·2·Δn_eff·d/λ: d = 3 µm gives 2π×(2×0.15×3/0.532) = 1.69×2π at 532 nm but only 0.85×2π at 1064 nm, a fail; d = 4 µm gives 1.13×2π at 1064 nm and 2.26×2π at 532 nm, so both wavelengths wrap to 2π. The price is response: τ_off = γ₁d²/(π²K) = 0.1×16×10⁻¹²/(9.87×10⁻¹¹) ≈ 16 ms, 1.8 times slower than the 9 ms of a 3 µm cell. Displaying an 8-pixel-period blaze (p = 8 µm) at 532 nm steers by sinθ = 0.532/64 = 0.0083 (0.48°), moving the focus 2.5 mm for f = 300 mm; the theoretical efficiency sinc²(1/8) = 95% times reflectance 0.90 and fill factor 0.956 gives 81.7%. If the lookup table maps 2π to grey level 200, each level is 0.0314 rad and quantization loss is negligible. With phase flicker σ = 0.15 rad, Strehl ≈ exp(−0.0225) ≈ 0.978. Values are teaching assumptions.
history: 1970 年代 Hughes 的液晶光閥首次把液晶用於光學影像調制；1990 年代矽基液晶（LCOS）為投影顯示而發展出高解析 CMOS 背板，2000 年代前後 Hamamatsu、Boulder Nonlinear Systems（今 Meadowlark Optics）與 HOLOEYE 把它改造成純相位調制器，並隨全像光鑷、顯微鏡自適應光學與電信波長選擇開關普及。2010 年代起，介電膜反射層與水冷封裝讓調制器能承受數百瓦雷射，進入雷射加工與平行微影；本課只整理公開的物理與校正方法。~In the 1970s the Hughes liquid-crystal light valve first used liquid crystal for optical image modulation; in the 1990s liquid crystal on silicon (LCOS) developed high-resolution CMOS backplanes for projection displays, and around the 2000s Hamamatsu, Boulder Nonlinear Systems (now Meadowlark Optics) and HOLOEYE turned it into phase-only modulators that spread with holographic optical tweezers, adaptive optics for microscopy and wavelength-selective switches in telecom. From the 2010s dielectric mirror layers and water-cooled packages let modulators withstand several hundred watts of laser power, entering laser processing and parallel lithography; this course covers only public physics and calibration methods.
